nodes.description: IERC20 token instance stored by GiveawayContract; used for balance queries and transfers out of the contract.
mapping(uint256=>TokenInputInfo) holding input token address and input/output rates per id (0..2).
Private nested mapping balances[id][account] tracking deposited amounts used to compute dividends.
mapping(address=>bool) guarding each address against claiming twice.
Running total of weighted dividends; divisor for pro-rata token/ETH distribution and reduced on claim.
Ownable owner address, set at construction and mutated by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
GiveawayContract constructor: stores _tokenAccel into tokenAccel; Ownable constructor sets _owner to deployer.
onlyOwner setter writing tokenInput[id].addr, rateInput and rateOutput for id < 3.
Payable receive hook accepting plain ETH into the contract balance.
onlyOwner drain: transfers full token balance and full ETH balance to msg.sender via external calls.
onlyOwner batch writer of balances[id][account] that also accumulates totalDevidend using rateOutput/rateInput.
View function computing pro-rata token, ETH and dividend amounts for an account from balances and totalDevidend.
Public claim: marks claimed[msg.sender], computes entitlement, sends tokens and ETH externally, then decrements totalDevidend.
Ownable view returning _owner; used by the onlyOwner modifier check.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner after zero-address check.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Checked addition with overflow revert, used via using SafeMath for uint256.
Checked subtraction with underflow revert, used via using SafeMath for uint256.
Checked multiplication with overflow revert, used via using SafeMath for uint256.
Checked division with zero-divisor revert, used via using SafeMath for uint256.
Caller-controlled address; used as recipient of token/ETH transfers and as claimed/balances index.
External ERC20 transfer of the contract's full token balance to msg.sender in ownerWithdrawEthAndToken.
External ETH transfer of the whole contract balance to msg.sender in ownerWithdrawEthAndToken.
External ERC20 transfer of computed token amount to msg.sender inside claim.
External ETH transfer of computed eth amount to msg.sender inside claim, executed before totalDevidend is updated.
Constructor address parameter for the ERC20 token used by the giveaway contract.
Token slot id parameter bounded to < 3 in ownerAddInputTokenForSwap.
Address of the accepted input token stored into tokenInput[id].addr.
Input rate divisor stored into tokenInput[id].rateInput.
Output rate multiplier stored into tokenInput[id].rateOutput.
Token slot id parameter bounded to < 3 in ownerSetupTokenBalance.
Array of account addresses whose balances are set in ownerSetupTokenBalance.
Array of deposit amounts used for balances and totalDevidend accumulation.
Account address argument of getClaimableAmount used to look up balances.
New owner address argument of transferOwnership.
Accumulated per-account dividend computed in the getClaimableAmount loop.
Computed token payout amount returned by getClaimableAmount and consumed by claim.
Computed ETH payout amount returned by getClaimableAmount and consumed by claim.
Computed dividend value returned by getClaimableAmount and subtracted from totalDevidend in claim.
Loop index used to iterate over accounts and over the three token slots.
Local address in the Ownable constructor holding the deployer from _msgSender().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _tokenAccel is assigned into the tokenAccel state variable.
Constructor executes the tokenAccel assignment.
Ownable constructor derives the initial owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Local msgSender from _msgSender() is written into _owner.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
id parameter indexes the tokenInput mapping.
_inputToken parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].addr.
_inputRate parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].rateInput.
_outputRate parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].rateOutput.
ownerAddInputTokenForSwap writes the tokenInput state entries.
onlyOwner modifier gates ownerAddInputTokenForSwap on the caller address.
id parameter selects the balances slot in ownerSetupTokenBalance.
accounts array elements are used as balances keys.
amount array elements are written into balances[id][accounts[i]].
Loop index i selects the accounts/amount pair written into balances.
ownerSetupTokenBalance writes the balances mapping.
onlyOwner modifier gates ownerSetupTokenBalance on the caller address.
amount is multiplied by rateOutput and divided by rateInput, then added to totalDevidend.
rateInput feeds the SafeMath.mul/div chain that computes the dividend weight.
rateOutput feeds the SafeMath.mul chain that computes the dividend weight.
rateInput is the divisor in the SafeMath.div call; zero rate would revert.
rateOutput flows into the dividend division expression.
ownerSetupTokenBalance increases totalDevidend by the weighted amount.
ownerSetupTokenBalance uses SafeMath.add for totalDevidend accumulation.
ownerSetupTokenBalance uses SafeMath.mul for the dividend weight.
ownerSetupTokenBalance uses SafeMath.div for the dividend weight.
msg.sender is used as the claimed mapping key, allowing any caller to gate their own claim.
claim writes claimed[msg.sender] = true before external calls.
claim passes msg.sender as the account argument of getClaimableAmount.
claim calls getClaimableAmount to compute the payout amounts.
account parameter indexes balances[i][account] inside getClaimableAmount.
totalDevidend is read as the pro-rata divisor in getClaimableAmount.
balances[i][account] is read to compute the account dividend.
tokenInput[i] rates are read in the getClaimableAmount loop.
tokenAccel.balanceOf(address(this)) is read to size the token payout.
getClaimableAmount accumulates the account entitlement into yourDividend.
yourDividend feeds the tokens payout calculation.
yourDividend feeds the eth payout calculation.
yourDividend is returned as the dividend value.
getClaimableAmount uses SafeMath.add when accumulating yourDividend.
getClaimableAmount uses SafeMath.mul for balance/rate and pro-rata scaling.
getClaimableAmount uses SafeMath.div with totalDevidend as divisor.
claim performs an external ERC20 transfer to the caller-controlled recipient.
claim performs an external ETH transfer to the caller-controlled recipient.
msg.sender is the recipient of the token transfer executed inside claim.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH transfer executed inside claim.
ETH transfer to msg.sender can reenter claim before totalDevidend is decremented.
claim decrements totalDevidend after the external transfers.
dividend returned by getClaimableAmount is subtracted from totalDevidend.
claim uses SafeMath.sub to reduce totalDevidend.
onlyOwner modifier restricts ownerWithdrawEthAndToken to the owner address.
ownerWithdrawEthAndToken performs an external ERC20 transfer of the whole balance.
ownerWithdrawEthAndToken performs an external ETH transfer of the whole balance.
msg.sender is the recipient of the token drain call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH drain call.
ETH transfer to the caller can reenter ownerWithdrawEthAndToken before balances are cleared.
onlyOwner compares owner() result against _msgSender().
owner() reads the _owner state variable for the access check.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
newOwner parameter overwrites the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes _owner after the zero-address check.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), removing all privileged functions.
receive() increases the ETH balance later distributed through tokenAccel/ETH payouts.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor address argument only feeds the tokenAccel state assignment; fold it into the constructor node.
Slot id parameter is only meaningful as the write index of the tokenInput setter.
Address parameter is consumed solely by the tokenInput write inside the setter.
Rate divisor parameter is only stored by the setter.
Rate multiplier parameter is only stored by the setter.
Slot id parameter only selects the balances slot written by the batch setter.
Account array is only iterated for balances writes inside the batch setter.
Amount array drives balances writes and totalDevidend accumulation in the batch setter.
Account argument is only used to index balances in the payout computation.
New owner address is only assigned into _owner by transferOwnership.
Local accumulator exists only inside the getClaimableAmount payout loop.
Local token payout is produced by getClaimableAmount and returned to claim.
Local ETH payout is produced by getClaimableAmount and returned to claim.
Local dividend value is produced by getClaimableAmount and consumed when claim reduces totalDevidend.
Loop index exists only to iterate the accounts/amount arrays and the token slots.
Local holding _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor only initializes _owner.
